title: Fetch a granted skill's full content
notes: Returns the skill's fully materialized text (parameters resolved, inline dependencies spliced in, markers executed) — the real content behind the one-line teaser you already see in your skill catalog. Requires an approved grant for this exact slug.

title: Fetch a skill with static parameter arguments
notes: A value in params overrides that same parameter's agent_context_resolvers dynamic binding, when both exist.

title: Fetch a skill that composes a fork-mode dependency
notes: fork_role is required only when the skill (or one of its composed dependencies) declares fork-mode composition — there is no default role. A pending-approval response names a run_id to poll via subagent_status before retrying.
